Rate_Name: Test Case - Fixed 315,000 kWh CBL Hybrid
Rate_Description: Planning-only synthetic usage tariff with a fixed 315,000 kWh monthly CBL, a $0.045876/kWh fuel surcharge on the CBL, and calendar-month incremental energy prices.
Basic_Information_Comments: The PLM energy-block boundaries are permanently resolved using a 509 kW reference billing demand. This is an approximation and does not calculate monthly billing demand.
Energy_Comments: The first 315,000 kWh receives the fixed PLM-derived blocks plus a $0.045876/kWh fuel surcharge. Every additional kWh receives only the applicable calendar-month incremental price. There are no separate demand or fixed charges.
